fast.$description: (Raw value. Do not use directly in components.) Small state changes: hover, press, focus, popups leaving.

base.$description: (Raw value. Do not use directly in components.) Elements entering or moving a short distance.

slow.$description: (Raw value. Do not use directly in components.) Large surfaces crossing the screen, such as a drawer.

slower.$description: (Raw value. Do not use directly in components.) Long, deliberate motion such as progress filling and counting.

standard.$description: (Raw value. Do not use directly in components.) Default curve. Quick start, soft landing.

enter.$description: (Raw value. Do not use directly in components.) Decelerate. For elements arriving on screen.

exit.$description: (Raw value. Do not use directly in components.) Accelerate. For elements leaving the screen.

short.$description: (Raw value. Do not use directly in components.) 4px travel for popups nudging into place.

subtle.$description: (Raw value. Do not use directly in components.) Starting scale for a surface growing into place.
